en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 1:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are expected over the territory this afternoon under an active southerly airstream.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the Thunderstorm Warning, which remains in force until 1:30 p.m. today. A few squally thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong.

The warning was first issued at 5:20 a.m. and has been extended several times through the morning. Lightning was detected within the New Territories East, Hong Kong Island and Kowloon between 10:45 and 11:45 a.m., with rainfall of up to several millimetres recorded in various districts.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek shelter, stay away from water and avoid high ground or conductive objects. An active southerly airstream is bringing showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午1時30分
zh.dek: 天文台表示受活躍偏南氣流影響，預料本港今午有幾陣狂風雷暴。
body: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至今日下午1時30分，預料香港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
警告於清晨5時20分發出，上午曾多次延長。上午10時45分至11時45分期間，新界東、港島及九龍曾錄得閃電，多區錄得數毫米雨量。
天文台呼籲市民如身處戶外請到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿站立高地或接近導電物體。活躍偏南氣流正為廣東沿岸帶來驟雨及雷暴。
